-- 萝卜4小游戏37：所选新增批次D1-D7按商品购买人数、去重订单次数。
-- 新增=全历史register最早日期；D1=注册当天；各Dn分别成熟至昨日。
-- 每个Dn成熟新增样本为0时输出NULL；已有成熟样本但未购买商品时输出0。
-- 截至昨日全历史订单先去重，再关联注册日，避免日期筛选截断首日之外订单。
-- 媒体Selector为完整条件，全部=1=1；新增样本和订单使用同一用户媒体映射。
SELECT
    m.product_id AS "商品ID",
    m.product_name AS "商品名称",
    c.n1 AS "D1成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n1 > 0 THEN m.u1 END AS "D1购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n1 > 0 THEN m.o1 END AS "D1购买次数",
    c.n2 AS "D2成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n2 > 0 THEN m.u2 END AS "D2购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n2 > 0 THEN m.o2 END AS "D2购买次数",
    c.n3 AS "D3成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n3 > 0 THEN m.u3 END AS "D3购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n3 > 0 THEN m.o3 END AS "D3购买次数",
    c.n4 AS "D4成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n4 > 0 THEN m.u4 END AS "D4购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n4 > 0 THEN m.o4 END AS "D4购买次数",
    c.n5 AS "D5成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n5 > 0 THEN m.u5 END AS "D5购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n5 > 0 THEN m.o5 END AS "D5购买次数",
    c.n6 AS "D6成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n6 > 0 THEN m.u6 END AS "D6购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n6 > 0 THEN m.o6 END AS "D6购买次数",
    c.n7 AS "D7成熟新增人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n7 > 0 THEN m.u7 END AS "D7购买人数",
    CASE WHEN c.n7 > 0 THEN m.o7 END AS "D7购买次数"
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, product_name,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 1 THEN pid END) AS u1,
           count_if(new_day = 1) AS o1,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 2 THEN pid END) AS u2,
           count_if(new_day = 2) AS o2,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 3 THEN pid END) AS u3,
           count_if(new_day = 3) AS o3,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 4 THEN pid END) AS u4,
           count_if(new_day = 4) AS o4,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 5 THEN pid END) AS u5,
           count_if(new_day = 5) AS o5,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 6 THEN pid END) AS u6,
           count_if(new_day = 6) AS o6,
           count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN new_day = 7 THEN pid END) AS u7,
           count_if(new_day = 7) AS o7
    FROM (
        SELECT p.pid, p.product_id, p.product_name,
               date_diff('day', cohorts.reg_day, p.pay_day) + 1 AS new_day
        FROM (
            SELECT pid, product_id, product_name, pay_day
            FROM (
                SELECT s.*,
                       row_number() OVER (
                           PARTITION BY pid, order_key
                           ORDER BY pay_time, product_id, product_name, pay_amount
                       ) AS order_rn
                FROM (
                    SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                           coalesce(nullif(trim(cast(order_id AS varchar)), ''),
                               concat('__missing__|', cast("#event_time" AS varchar), '|',
                                   coalesce(cast(product_id AS varchar), ''), '|',
                                   coalesce(cast(product_name AS varchar), ''), '|',
                                   cast(pay_amount AS varchar))) AS order_key,
                           cast(product_id AS varchar) AS product_id,
                           coalesce(nullif(cast(product_name AS varchar), ''), '未获取商品名称') AS product_name,
                           try_cast(pay_amount AS double) AS pay_amount,
                           cast("#event_time" AS timestamp) AS pay_time,
                           date("$part_date") AS pay_day
                    FROM ta.v_event_37
                    WHERE "$part_event" = 'order_finish'
                      AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
                      AND date("#event_time") < current_date
                      AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                      AND "#event_time" IS NOT NULL
                      AND try_cast(pay_amount AS double) > 0
                ) s
            ) ranked_orders
            WHERE order_rn = 1
        ) p
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT c.pid, c.reg_day,
                   coalesce(u.media_name, '自然量') AS media_name
            FROM (
                SELECT pid, reg_day
                FROM (
                    SELECT pid, reg_day, cast(reg_day AS varchar) AS "$part_date"
                    FROM (
                        SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                               min(date("$part_date")) AS reg_day
                        FROM ta.v_event_37
                        WHERE "$part_event" = 'register'
                          AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
                          AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                        GROUP BY 1
                    ) all_registration
                ) registration_dates
                WHERE ${PartDate:date1}
            ) c
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                       coalesce(max(nullif(cast(ad_platform AS varchar), '')), '自然量') AS media_name
                FROM ta.v_user_37
                WHERE "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY 1
            ) u ON c.pid = u.pid
        ) cohorts ON p.pid = cohorts.pid
            AND p.pay_day BETWEEN cohorts.reg_day AND date_add('day', 6, cohorts.reg_day)
        WHERE ${Selector:media}
    ) purchase_days
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name
) m
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT count_if(reg_day < current_date) AS n1,
           count_if(date_add('day', 1, reg_day) < current_date) AS n2,
           count_if(date_add('day', 2, reg_day) < current_date) AS n3,
           count_if(date_add('day', 3, reg_day) < current_date) AS n4,
           count_if(date_add('day', 4, reg_day) < current_date) AS n5,
           count_if(date_add('day', 5, reg_day) < current_date) AS n6,
           count_if(date_add('day', 6, reg_day) < current_date) AS n7
    FROM (
        SELECT c.pid, c.reg_day,
               coalesce(u.media_name, '自然量') AS media_name
        FROM (
            SELECT pid, reg_day
            FROM (
                SELECT pid, reg_day, cast(reg_day AS varchar) AS "$part_date"
                FROM (
                    SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                           min(date("$part_date")) AS reg_day
                    FROM ta.v_event_37
                    WHERE "$part_event" = 'register'
                      AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
                      AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY 1
                ) all_registration
            ) registration_dates
            WHERE ${PartDate:date1}
        ) c
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                   coalesce(max(nullif(cast(ad_platform AS varchar), '')), '自然量') AS media_name
            FROM ta.v_user_37
            WHERE "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY 1
        ) u ON c.pid = u.pid
    ) media_cohorts
    WHERE ${Selector:media}
) c
ORDER BY m.product_id, m.product_name

events.sql:
-- 萝卜4小游戏37：每日商品购买，正金额完成订单按用户+订单号去重，金额为元。
-- 全部统计截至昨日；媒体Selector完整条件在两个media_name作用域分别应用。
-- GROUPING SETS同次聚合产生商品与当日全商品总计；总计在商品筛选之前求出。
-- 付费率分母为login当日#user_id去重；商品人数占比分母为当日全部商品付费人数。
SELECT
    p.day AS "日期",
    p.product_id AS "商品ID",
    p.product_name AS "商品名称",
    p.payers AS "付费人数",
    p.orders AS "付费次数",
    cast(round(p.payers * 1.0000 / nullif(a.active_users, 0), 4) AS decimal(18,4)) AS "付费率",
    cast(round(p.payers * 1.0000 / nullif(p.total_payers, 0), 4) AS decimal(18,4)) AS "付费人数占比",
    cast(round(p.amount, 2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS "付费金额_元",
    cast(round(p.amount / nullif(p.total_amount, 0), 4) AS decimal(18,4)) AS "付费金额占比",
    cast(round(p.amount / nullif(p.payers, 0), 2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS "付费ARPPU_元"
FROM (
    SELECT day, product_id, product_name, payers, orders, amount, is_total,
           max(CASE WHEN is_total = 1 THEN payers END) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS total_payers,
           max(CASE WHEN is_total = 1 THEN amount END) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS total_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT day, product_id, product_name,
               grouping(product_id) AS is_total,
               count(DISTINCT pid) AS payers,
               count(*) AS orders,
               sum(pay_amount) AS amount
        FROM (
            SELECT d.pid, d.day, d.product_id, d.product_name, d.pay_amount,
                   coalesce(u.media_name, '自然量') AS media_name
            FROM (
                SELECT pid, date("$part_date") AS day, product_id, product_name, pay_amount
                FROM (
                    SELECT s.*,
                           row_number() OVER (
                               PARTITION BY pid, order_key
                               ORDER BY pay_time, product_id, product_name, pay_amount
                           ) AS order_rn
                    FROM (
                        SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                               "$part_date",
                               coalesce(nullif(trim(cast(order_id AS varchar)), ''),
                                   concat('__missing__|', cast("#event_time" AS varchar), '|',
                                       coalesce(cast(product_id AS varchar), ''), '|',
                                       coalesce(cast(product_name AS varchar), ''), '|',
                                       cast(pay_amount AS varchar))) AS order_key,
                               cast(product_id AS varchar) AS product_id,
                               coalesce(nullif(cast(product_name AS varchar), ''), '未获取商品名称') AS product_name,
                               try_cast(pay_amount AS double) AS pay_amount,
                               cast("#event_time" AS timestamp) AS pay_time
                        FROM ta.v_event_37
                        WHERE "$part_event" = 'order_finish'
                          AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
                          AND date("#event_time") < current_date
                          AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                          AND "#event_time" IS NOT NULL
                          AND try_cast(pay_amount AS double) > 0
                    ) s
                ) ranked_orders
                WHERE order_rn = 1
                  AND ${PartDate:date}
            ) d
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                       coalesce(max(nullif(cast(ad_platform AS varchar), '')), '自然量') AS media_name
                FROM ta.v_user_37
                WHERE "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY 1
            ) u ON d.pid = u.pid
        ) media_orders
        WHERE ${Selector:media}
        GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((day, product_id, product_name), (day))
    ) daily_grouping
) p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT day, count(DISTINCT pid) AS active_users
    FROM (
        SELECT e."$part_date" AS day_string,
               date(e."$part_date") AS day,
               cast(e."#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
               coalesce(u.media_name, '自然量') AS media_name
        FROM ta.v_event_37 e
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                   coalesce(max(nullif(cast(ad_platform AS varchar), '')), '自然量') AS media_name
            FROM ta.v_user_37
            WHERE "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY 1
        ) u ON cast(e."#user_id" AS varchar) = u.pid
        WHERE e."$part_event" = 'login'
          AND e."$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
          AND e."#user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND ${PartDate:date}
    ) media_active
    WHERE ${Selector:media}
    GROUP BY day
) a ON p.day = a.day
WHERE p.is_total = 0
ORDER BY p.day DESC, p.amount DESC, p.product_id, p.product_name

-- 新增按全历史register最早日期；D1为注册当天，统计至昨日。
-- 保留现有时长SQL的CTE结构，先压到用户日，避免重复JOIN。
WITH reg AS (
    SELECT "#user_id",min("$part_date") AS reg_day
    FROM ta.v_event_37
    WHERE "$part_event"='register' AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
), cohort AS (
    SELECT "#user_id",reg_day,media_name
    FROM (
      SELECT r."#user_id",r.reg_day,r.reg_day AS "$part_date",
             coalesce(nullif(trim(u.media_name),''),'自然量') AS media_name
      FROM reg r LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT "#user_id",max(ad_platform) AS media_name
        FROM ta.v_user_37 GROUP BY 1
      ) u ON r."#user_id"=u."#user_id"
    ) c
    WHERE ${PartDate:date1} AND ${Selector:media}
      AND date(reg_day)<current_date
), daily AS (
    SELECT "$part_date" AS day,"#user_id",
           max(CASE WHEN "$part_event"='ta_mg_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active,
           sum(CASE WHEN "$part_event"='ta_mg_hide' AND "#duration">=0 AND "#duration"<86400
                    THEN "#duration" ELSE 0 END) AS seconds
    FROM ta.v_event_37
    WHERE "$part_event" IN ('ta_mg_show','ta_mg_hide')
      AND "$part_date">=(SELECT min(reg_day) FROM cohort)
      AND "$part_date"<=cast(least(
            date_add('day',6,(SELECT max(date(reg_day)) FROM cohort)),
            date_add('day',-1,current_date)) AS varchar)
      AND "#user_id" IN (SELECT "#user_id" FROM cohort)
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT date(c.reg_day) AS "新增日期",
       count(DISTINCT c."#user_id") AS "新增人数",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=0 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=0 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D1人均在线时长（分钟）",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=1 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=1 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D2人均在线时长（分钟）",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=2 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=2 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D3人均在线时长（分钟）",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=3 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=3 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D4人均在线时长（分钟）",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=4 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=4 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D5人均在线时长（分钟）",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=5 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=5 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D6人均在线时长（分钟）",
       round(sum(CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=6 AND d.active=1 THEN coalesce(d.seconds,0) ELSE 0 END)
             /nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_diff('day',date(c.reg_day),date(d.day))=6 AND d.active=1 THEN c."#user_id" END),0)/60.0,2)
             AS "D7人均在线时长（分钟）"
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN daily d
  ON c."#user_id"=d."#user_id"
 AND date(d.day) BETWEEN date(c.reg_day) AND date_add('day',6,date(c.reg_day))
GROUP BY c.reg_day
ORDER BY c.reg_day DESC

-- 萝卜4小游戏37：新增用户全历史首次有效完成订单，归因至首充前最近进入的关卡。
-- 观察截至昨日；register全历史MIN后再筛选新增日期；支付金额原值为元。
-- 先去重订单、选每人首笔、再将关卡关联压成每人一行，避免金额被关卡记录放大。
-- 媒体Selector是完整条件：全部=1=1，指定媒体=media_name='自然量'等。
SELECT
    first_level AS "首充前最近进入关卡",
    product_id AS "商品ID",
    product_name AS "商品名称",
    count(DISTINCT pid) AS "首充人数",
    cast(round(sum(pay_amount), 2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS "首充金额_元"
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.pid, f.order_key, f.product_id, f.product_name, f.pay_amount,
        coalesce(max_by(l.level_id, ROW(l.level_time, l.level_id)), '未获取') AS first_level
    FROM (
        SELECT p.pid, p.order_key, p.product_id, p.product_name,
               p.pay_amount, p.pay_time
        FROM (
            SELECT d.*,
                   row_number() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY pid
                       ORDER BY pay_time, order_key, product_id, product_name
                   ) AS first_rn
            FROM (
                SELECT pid, order_key, product_id, product_name, pay_amount, pay_time, pay_day
                FROM (
                    SELECT s.*,
                           row_number() OVER (
                               PARTITION BY pid, order_key
                               ORDER BY pay_time, product_id, product_name, pay_amount
                           ) AS order_rn
                    FROM (
                        SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                               coalesce(nullif(trim(cast(order_id AS varchar)), ''),
                                   concat('__missing__|', cast("#event_time" AS varchar), '|',
                                       coalesce(cast(product_id AS varchar), ''), '|',
                                       coalesce(cast(product_name AS varchar), ''), '|',
                                       cast(pay_amount AS varchar))) AS order_key,
                               cast(product_id AS varchar) AS product_id,
                               coalesce(nullif(cast(product_name AS varchar), ''), '未获取商品名称') AS product_name,
                               try_cast(pay_amount AS double) AS pay_amount,
                               cast("#event_time" AS timestamp) AS pay_time,
                               date("$part_date") AS pay_day
                        FROM ta.v_event_37
                        WHERE "$part_event" = 'order_finish'
                          AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
                          AND date("#event_time") < current_date
                          AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                          AND "#event_time" IS NOT NULL
                          AND try_cast(pay_amount AS double) > 0
                    ) s
                ) ranked_orders
                WHERE order_rn = 1
            ) d
        ) p
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT c.pid, c.reg_day,
                   coalesce(u.media_name, '自然量') AS media_name
            FROM (
                SELECT pid, reg_day
                FROM (
                    SELECT pid, reg_day, cast(reg_day AS varchar) AS "$part_date"
                    FROM (
                        SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                               min(date("$part_date")) AS reg_day
                        FROM ta.v_event_37
                        WHERE "$part_event" = 'register'
                          AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
                          AND "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                        GROUP BY 1
                    ) all_registration
                ) registration_dates
                WHERE ${PartDate:date1}
            ) c
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
                       coalesce(max(nullif(cast(ad_platform AS varchar), '')), '自然量') AS media_name
                FROM ta.v_user_37
                WHERE "#user_id" IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY 1
            ) u ON c.pid = u.pid
        ) cohorts ON p.pid = cohorts.pid AND p.pay_day >= cohorts.reg_day
        WHERE p.first_rn = 1
          AND ${Selector:media}
    ) f
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT cast("#user_id" AS varchar) AS pid,
               nullif(trim(cast(level_id AS varchar)), '') AS level_id,
               cast("#event_time" AS timestamp) AS level_time
        FROM ta.v_event_37
        WHERE "$part_event" = 'level_start'
          AND "$part_date" <= cast(date_add('day', -1, current_date) AS varchar)
          AND "#event_time" IS NOT NULL
          AND nullif(trim(cast(level_id AS varchar)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ) l ON f.pid = l.pid AND l.level_time <= f.pay_time
    GROUP BY f.pid, f.order_key, f.product_id, f.product_name, f.pay_amount
) first_payment_level
GROUP BY first_level, product_id, product_name
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN first_level = '未获取' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    try_cast(split_part(first_level, '.', 1) AS bigint) ASC NULLS LAST,
    try_cast(split_part(first_level, '.', 2) AS bigint) ASC NULLS FIRST,
    first_level, product_id, product_name
